rivers_connecting.title: Master Plan for Connecting All Major Rivers in India

meta.title: Master Plan for Connecting All Major Rivers in India
meta.description: A pragmatic, engineering-plus-governance roadmap to sequence, fund, clear, build, and operate an All-India river interlinking program.

rivers_connecting.content: Great question, Vijaya Kumar! If by “master plan” you mean a pragmatic, engineering‑plus‑governance roadmap that can be used to **sequence, fund, clear, build, and operate** an All‑India river interlinking program, here’s a comprehensive plan aligned with today’s policy and project realities. --- ## 1) Purpose & Principles **Objectives** - Balance floods in the north/east and droughts in the west/south by moving monsoon surpluses to deficit basins. [1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indian_rivers_interlinking_project) - Add multi‑sector benefits: irrigation, drinking/industrial supply, hydro, inland navigation, ecological flows restoration, and aquifer recharge. [2](https://nwda.gov.in/content/innerpage/click-more.php) **Guiding principles** - **Basin‑first** hydrology (CWC/NWDA standards) and **environment‑first** appraisal (EIA/EMP with cumulative assessments where applicable). [3](https://cwc.gov.in/sites/default/files/nwauser/basinwise-asssmnt-wr9.pdf)[4](https://parivesh.nic.in/publicdocument/UPLOAD_OM_NOTIFICATION/IA_DOCS/1002_05082025053237.pdf) - **Cooperative federalism**: Centre–State compacts under the Special Committee for Interlinking of Rivers (SCILR); Supreme Court directions recognized the need for such a committee. [5](https://indiankanoon.org/doc/41857247/)[6](https://www.casemine.com/judgement/in/581180422713e1794798c478) - **International riparian sensitivity** for Himalayan links (Nepal/Bangladesh), sequencing domestic components first. [2](https://nwda.gov.in/content/innerpage/click-more.php) --- ## 2) What exists today (ground truth) - **National Perspective Plan (NPP)**: 30 links—**14 Himalayan** + **16 Peninsular**—identified by NWDA. **All 30 PFRs** done, **~26 FRs** done, **~11–13 DPRs** prepared; **Ken–Betwa** is the first under **implementation**. [7](https://pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=2149302)[8](https://cwc.gov.in/sites/default/files/sq-73.pdf) - **Ken–Betwa Link Project (KBLP)**: ₹44,605 cr; irrigation 10.62 lakh ha, drinking water to ~62 lakh people, 103 MW hydro + 27 MW solar; implementation underway with SPV (KBLPA). [9](https://nwda.gov.in/content/innerpage/project-at-glance.php)[8](https://cwc.gov.in/sites/default/files/sq-73.pdf) - **Godavari–Cauvery Corridor (3 links)** has draft DPRs; CWC’s revised hydrological vetting currently limits **diversion to ~4,189 MCM**, recasting earlier higher numbers—critical for south India planning (AP–TS–TN). [10](https://nwda.gov.in/upload/Godavari%28Inchampalli%29-Cauvery.pdf) --- ## 3) National architecture (who does what) - **SCILR (chaired by Union Jal Shakti Minister)**—policy steering, consensus building, quarterly reviews; **Task Force for ILR** for technical acceleration. [8](https://cwc.gov.in/sites/default/files/sq-73.pdf) - **NWDA**—basin studies, FR/DPR, stakeholder consultations, link packaging. [11](https://nwda.gov.in/upload/uploadfiles/files/NOTE%20ON%20INTERLINKING%20OF%20RIVERS.pdf) - **CWC**—hydrology vetting, techno‑economic appraisal; India‑WRIS basins/atlas for integrated data. [3](https://cwc.gov.in/sites/default/files/nwauser/basinwise-asssmnt-wr9.pdf)[12](https://www.nrsc.gov.in/nrscnew/resources_atlas.php) - **MoEFCC/EAC‑RVHEP**—EIA/forest/wildlife clearances; guidance on cumulative impact/CCS (case‑by‑case). [4](https://parivesh.nic.in/publicdocument/UPLOAD_OM_NOTIFICATION/IA_DOCS/1002_05082025053237.pdf) --- ## 4) Phased build plan (2026–2040) > **Rationale:** De‑risk early with priority links that (a) have mature DPRs, (b) resolve critical drought corridors, (c) minimal international issues, (d) can ride on existing storages/canals. ### Phase‑A (2026–2030): “Quick‑win & South‑centric backbone” 1) **Complete Ken–Betwa (Phase I & II)**; lock land, R&R, EMP, and commissioning of Daudhan + link canal (target by 2030). KPIs: irrigation, potable water, e‑flow compliance, tiger habitat offset deliverables. [9](https://nwda.gov.in/content/innerpage/project-at-glance.php) 2) **Godavari → Krishna → Pennar → Cauvery (GKPC) – Stage 1** - Implement within **~4,189 MCM** hydrology envelope cleared by CWC; **package as three EPC tranches** anchored to Polavaram–Vijayawada connectivity and southward transfers to Somasila → Grand Anicut. [10](https://nwda.gov.in/upload/Godavari%28Inchampalli%29-Cauvery.pdf) - **Tamil Nadu payoff**: structured augmentation for Cauvery delta and south TN (Vaigai–Gundar), synchronized with **Cauvery–Vaigai–Gundar DPR** already prepared. [11](https://nwda.gov.in/upload/uploadfiles/files/NOTE%20ON%20INTERLINKING%20OF%20RIVERS.pdf) 3) **Modified Parbati–Kalisindh–Chambal–ERCP (Rajasthan–MP)**: finish DPR appraisal segments already submitted; prioritize drinking & irrigation for water‑stressed districts. [8](https://cwc.gov.in/sites/default/files/sq-73.pdf) **Enablers (Phase‑A)** - **Finance**: Central 60% + State 40% baseline; tap **VGF/IIPDF** for project development and gap funding; ring‑fence O&M via long‑term annuity. [13](https://www.icra.in/Media/DownloadS3MediaRelease?Key=95e68ad9-a2a4-4947-adb2-8b57ca775230)[14](https://www.pppinindia.gov.in/) - **Data & Ops**: national telemetry (reservoir/river gauges), SCADA gates, near‑real‑time routing using CWC’s reservoir monitoring systems. [15](https://cwc.gov.in/en) ### Phase‑B (2030–2035): “Scale the spine & eastern flood moderation” 4) **GKPC – Stage 2**: incremental capacity subject to fresh hydrology (climate‑adjusted) and efficiency gains (lining, leakage control, micro‑irrigation coverage). [10](https://nwda.gov.in/upload/Godavari%28Inchampalli%29-Cauvery.pdf) 5) **Kosi–Ghaghra/Gandak → Ganga balancing links (Himalayan subset)** for flood moderation + lean‑season support downstream (domestic priority; cross‑border elements kept consultative). [16](https://sansad.in/getFile/annex/265/AS12_0R7n24.pdf?source=pqars) 6) **Bedti–Varada (peninsular west‑flowing correction)** integrated with Tungabhadra augmentation to stabilize north Karnataka command. DPR (draft) exists; finalize with Karnataka–AP concurrence. [11](https://nwda.gov.in/upload/uploadfiles/files/NOTE%20ON%20INTERLINKING%20OF%20RIVERS.pdf) ### Phase‑C (2035–2040): “Himalayan integration where feasible” 7) **Manas–Sankosh–Teesta–Ganga (MSTG)** and **Yamuna head‑reach optimization**—only after bilateral frameworks; focus on flood moderation + navigation synergies. [16](https://sansad.in/getFile/annex/265/AS12_0R7n24.pdf?source=pqars) 8) **Inter‑basin optimization & navigation**—select reaches as **National Waterways feeders** after ecological flow stabilization. [2](https://nwda.gov.in/content/innerpage/click-more.php) --- ## 5) Technical stack (how to design it right) **Hydrology & climate** - Use CWC basinwise assessments; re‑validate surpluses under **2020s–2030s climate scenarios** before sanctioning diversions (CWC noted storage/availability variability). [3](https://cwc.gov.in/sites/default/files/nwauser/basinwise-asssmnt-wr9.pdf)[17](https://www.chinimandi.com/water-reservoir-levels-depleting-fast-deficient-water-reported-in-godavari-krishna-and-cauvery-basins/) **Design** - Prioritize **gravity‑led** transfers; where lifts are unavoidable (e.g., segments in GKPC), apply **high‑efficiency pumps**, solar‑assisted captive power (as at KBLP). [9](https://nwda.gov.in/content/innerpage/project-at-glance.php) - **Canal modernization**: concrete lining, compacted subgrades, smart gates, telemetered discharge. [15](https://cwc.gov.in/en) - **Demand‑side pairing**: compulsory **micro‑irrigation** (drip/sprinkler) targets tied to water release entitlements; Pattiseema case study shows significant stabilization benefits for Krishna delta. [18](https://cigrjournal.org/index.php/Ejounral/article/download/9169/4445/45905) **Ops** - **Dynamic Operating Policy (DOP)** per link—rule curves tied to IMD forecasts + reservoir rule bands; publish weekly dashboards via NWDA/CWC portals. [15](https://cwc.gov.in/en) --- ## 6) Environmental & social safeguards (non‑negotiables) - **Project‑specific EIA/EMP** + wildlife/forest clearances; cumulative studies **as required** by MoEFCC guidance; biodiversity offsets and free‑flow reach preservation. [4](https://parivesh.nic.in/publicdocument/UPLOAD_OM_NOTIFICATION/IA_DOCS/1002_05082025053237.pdf) - **Ken–Betwa lessons**: tiger habitat compensation, tree felling minimization, and robust R&R for ~7,000+ affected families—use as benchmark for all links. [7](https://pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=2149302) - **Groundwater & salinity**: mandate conjunctive use plans to avoid waterlogging/salinity seen in legacy canal systems. [19](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Sharmistha-Basu/publication/281080708_Environmental_Issues_in_Interlinking_of_rivers_in_India/links/55e9708d08ae65b6389af41e/Environmental-Issues-in-Interlinking-of-rivers-in-India.pdf) - **Stakeholder consent**: structured consultations, gram sabha processes, fair compensation under RFCTLARR; publish SIA summaries. [7](https://pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=2149302) --- ## 7) Governance & agreements - **Inter‑State MoAs** for each link, specifying: water accounting, priority of uses, O&M cost‑sharing, dispute resolution window under SCILR; upload DPRs to **e‑PAMS** and CWC appraisal portals to keep a transparent trail. [8](https://cwc.gov.in/sites/default/files/sq-73.pdf) - **SCILR cadence**: bi‑annual public report to Parliament; this stems from the Supreme Court’s 2012 directives and subsequent compliance in 2014 on committee constitution. [5](https://indiankanoon.org/doc/41857247/)[6](https://www.casemine.com/judgement/in/581180422713e1794798c478) --- ## 8) Financing blueprint - **Capital mix**: Central budget 60% + State 40% (baseline), with **VGF** for non‑remunerative environmental/rehab components; use **IIPDF** for DPR/transaction prep. [13](https://www.icra.in/Media/DownloadS3MediaRelease?Key=95e68ad9-a2a4-4947-adb2-8b57ca775230)[14](https://www.pppinindia.gov.in/) - **Sequencing**: ICRA estimates ~₹2.6 lakh crore for four priority links by ~FY2035; ~₹80,000 crore EPC opportunities in next four years—plan award calendar accordingly. [13](https://www.icra.in/Media/DownloadS3MediaRelease?Key=95e68ad9-a2a4-4947-adb2-8b57ca775230) - **O&M fund**: ring‑fenced multi‑state O&M escrow fed by beneficiary charges (irrigation service fee + urban bulk supply tariff slabs). [14](https://www.pppinindia.gov.in/) --- ## 9) Risk register & mitigations | Risk | Example/Signal | Mitigation | |---|---|---| | Hydrology over‑commit | CWC recast of Godavari diversion to ~4,189 MCM | Stage‑gating; adaptive caps; annual hydrology audits. [10](https://nwda.gov.in/upload/Godavari%28Inchampalli%29-Cauvery.pdf) | | Environmental litigation | KBLP wildlife/forest impacts | Early biodiversity mapping; offsets; transparent EAC processes. [9](https://nwda.gov.in/content/innerpage/project-at-glance.php)[4](https://parivesh.nic.in/publicdocument/UPLOAD_OM_NOTIFICATION/IA_DOCS/1002_05082025053237.pdf) | | Inter‑state deadlock | PKC/ERCP benefit sharing | SCILR‑mediated MoAs; benefit‑sharing matrix published. [8](https://cwc.gov.in/sites/default/files/sq-73.pdf) | | Cost/time overrun | Mega civil EPC works | Milestone‑linked EPC, independent engineer, digital progress dashboards. [13](https://www.icra.in/Media/DownloadS3MediaRelease?Key=95e68ad9-a2a4-4947-adb2-8b57ca775230) | | Social displacement | KBLP R&R for ~7,193 PAFs | Enhanced R&R packages; third‑party SIA monitoring. [7](https://pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=2149302) | --- ## 10) South India (incl. Tamil Nadu) — what this plan delivers - **Cauvery security (augmentation)** via **GKPC Stage‑1** within the CWC‑accepted **~4,189 MCM** envelope, ramping up delta stabilization and supporting **Cauvery–Vaigai–Gundar** link already DPR’d. [10](https://nwda.gov.in/upload/Godavari%28Inchampalli%29-Cauvery.pdf)[11](https://nwda.gov.in/upload/uploadfiles/files/NOTE%20ON%20INTERLINKING%20OF%20RIVERS.pdf) - **Urban–industrial reliability** for Chennai region through system‑wide storage support and drought buffers, complementing local reuse/desal and inter‑basin top‑ups in bad monsoon years. [10](https://nwda.gov.in/upload/Godavari%28Inchampalli%29-Cauvery.pdf) --- ## 11) KPIs & transparency - **Water moved (MCM)** vs hydrology cap; **irrigation ha** added; **people served**; **e‑flows** achieved; **R&R closures**; **forest offsets** delivered; public dashboards via NWDA/CWC. [11](https://nwda.gov.in/upload/uploadfiles/files/NOTE%20ON%20INTERLINKING%20OF%20RIVERS.pdf)[15](https://cwc.gov.in/en) --- ## 12) Executive Gantt (high‑level) - **2026–27**: Financial closures for GKPC‑S1 packages; KBLP civil works ramp; PKC DPR appraisals closed. [9](https://nwda.gov.in/content/innerpage/project-at-glance.php)[10](https://nwda.gov.in/upload/Godavari%28Inchampalli%29-Cauvery.pdf)[8](https://cwc.gov.in/sites/default/files/sq-73.pdf) - **2028–30**: KBLP commissioning; GKPC initial transfers to Somasila & Grand Anicut; Bedti–Varada MoA + tender. [9](https://nwda.gov.in/content/innerpage/project-at-glance.php)[10](https://nwda.gov.in/upload/Godavari%28Inchampalli%29-Cauvery.pdf) - **2031–35**: GKPC‑S2 (subject to climate‑adjusted hydrology); Kosi–Ghaghra link segment(s) post‑consensus. [10](https://nwda.gov.in/upload/Godavari%28Inchampalli%29-Cauvery.pdf)[16](https://sansad.in/getFile/annex/265/AS12_0R7n24.pdf?source=pqars) - **2036–40**: MSTG/Himalayan selective links after riparian frameworks. [16](https://sansad.in/getFile/annex/265/AS12_0R7n24.pdf?source=pqars) --- ## 13) Why this plan is realistic - It **uses today’s actual statuses** (PFR/FR/DPR, budgets, committees) rather than a green‑field wishlist. [7](https://pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=2149302)[8](https://cwc.gov.in/sites/default/files/sq-73.pdf) - It **front‑loads southern augmentation** (GKPC) that Chennai/TN care about, but **within the hydrology constraints CWC has recently vetted**. [10](https://nwda.gov.in/upload/Godavari%28Inchampalli%29-Cauvery.pdf) - It **keeps Himalayan links for later**, recognizing cross‑border dependencies. [2](https://nwda.gov.in/content/innerpage/click-more.php) --- ### Want this tailored into a **project charter + slide deck** (with a Gantt, budgets, risk heatmap) you can share at work? Tell me: - which corridor you want prioritized (e.g., **Godavari→Cauvery** for TN), - whether you want **merge vs rebase** (kidding 😄)—actually, whether you want **merge (EPC)** or **hybrid PPP** packaging, and - your preferred KPIs. I’ll generate a concise **PowerPoint** with maps, timelines, and funding options aligned to **PPP/VGF/IIPDF** norms and **NWDA/CWC** checkpoints. [14](https://www.pppinindia.gov.in/) --- **Sources & key references** Policy/status & governance: NWDA notes; PIB/Lok Sabha/Rajya Sabha Q&A; SCILR/SC directions. [11](https://nwda.gov.in/upload/uploadfiles/files/NOTE%20ON%20INTERLINKING%20OF%20RIVERS.pdf)[7](https://pib.gov.in/PressReleaseIframePage.aspx?PRID=2149302)[8](https://cwc.gov.in/sites/default/files/sq-73.pdf)[5](https://indiankanoon.org/doc/41857247/)[6](https://www.casemine.com/judgement/in/581180422713e1794798c478) Priority links & DPR/FR: NWDA project pages (KBLP, GKPC, Bedti‑Varada). [9](https://nwda.gov.in/content/innerpage/project-at-glance.php)[10](https://nwda.gov.in/upload/Godavari%28Inchampalli%29-Cauvery.pdf)[11](https://nwda.gov.in/upload/uploadfiles/files/NOTE%20ON%20INTERLINKING%20OF%20RIVERS.pdf) Hydrology & basins: CWC basinwise assessments; WRIS/River Basin Atlas. [3](https://cwc.gov.in/sites/default/files/nwauser/basinwise-asssmnt-wr9.pdf)[12](https://www.nrsc.gov.in/nrscnew/resources_atlas.php) Environment & social: MoEFCC guidance (EIA/EAC), literature on impacts & safeguards. [4](https://parivesh.nic.in/publicdocument/UPLOAD_OM_NOTIFICATION/IA_DOCS/1002_05082025053237.pdf)[19](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Sharmistha-Basu/publication/281080708_Environmental_Issues_in_Interlinking_of_rivers_in_India/links/55e9708d08ae65b6389af41e/Environmental-Issues-in-Interlinking-of-rivers-in-India.pdf) Financing & pipeline: ICRA opportunity note; PPP/VGF/IIPDF portals. [13](https://www.icra.in/Media/DownloadS3MediaRelease?Key=95e68ad9-a2a4-4947-adb2-8b57ca775230)[14](https://www.pppinindia.gov.in/) If you want, I can also add a **Tamil‑focused annex** showing annualized flows to Cauvery sub‑basins under GKPC‑S1 and indicative allocations for Chennai’s drought years. --- ## 14) Gantt chart for project timelines (ASCII) > **Time axis**: 2026 → 2040 (half‑year ticks). Use this as a visual in your page; the structured `ganttData` below mirrors the same schedule for chart components. ``` Legend: [=====] Active [###] Approvals/Finance [~~~] O&M/Monitoring Years: 2026 | 2027 | 2028 | 2029 | 2030 | 2031 | 2032 | 2033 | 2034 | 2035 | 2036 | 2037 | 2038 | 2039 | 2040 H1 H2 H1 H2 H1 H2 H1 H2 H1 H2 H1 H2 H1 H2 H1 H2 H1 H2 H1 H2 H1 H2 H1 H2 H1 H2 H1 H2 H1 H2 1) Ken–Betwa (Phase I & II) [###] Approvals/Finance |==== Work & R&R ===========================| Commissioning |~~~ O&M ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~| 26H1–27H2 27H2 30H2 30H2–> 2) GKPC Stage‑1 (Godavari→Krishna→Pennar→Cauvery) [###] Finance & Tender |=========== EPC Tranche A ===========| |========= Tranche B =========| |= Tranche C =| Ramp‑up |~~~ 26H1–27H2 27H2–29H1 28H2–30H1 29H2–30H2 30H2–31H1 31H1–> 3) Modified PKC–ERCP (Rajasthan–MP) [###] DPR Appraisal/MoA |============= Works ===============| Progressive Handover |~~~ O&M ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~| 26H1–27H2 28H1–32H2 33H1–33H2 33H2–> 4) Bedti–Varada Link [###] Consensus & DPR |=========== Construction ===========| Initial Ops |~~~ O&M ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~| 28H2–30H1 30H2–33H1 33H2 33H2–> 5) GKPC Stage‑2 (Hydrology‑gated) [###] Re‑vet Hydrology |============= Capacity Add ==============| Optimization |~~~ O&M ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~| 30H2–31H2 32H1–35H2 36H1 36H1–> 6) Kosi–Ghaghra/Gandak → Ganga (select links) [###] Consensus & DPR |============= Priority Segments ==============| Ops Ramp |~~~ O&M ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~| 31H1–32H2 33H1–35H2 36H1–36H2 36H2–> 7) MSTG & Yamuna head‑reach (bilateral dependent) [###] Intl Frameworks |=========== Phased Works (if cleared) =========| Ops |~~~ O&M ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~| 34H2–36H1 36H2–39H1 39H2 39H2–> ```
rivers_connecting.intro: A pragmatic, engineering-plus-governance roadmap to sequence, fund, clear, build, and operate an All-India river interlinking program.
